metadata.title: Slate Component Library Demo
metadata.purpose: Demonstrate the 8 new HyperFrames components in a narrative flow.
metadata.narrative_arc: Open with the system → prove the win → show how to use it → social proof → ask
metadata.notes_for_future_agents: CompareSlider.leftSrc/rightSrc and CalloutPin.baseSrc are intentionally empty in this demo to exercise the components' fallback rendering. In a production SCF, populate these with real asset paths (e.g., assets/before.png, assets/dashboard.png) generated via foundry_image_gen.
